data.one_liner: Integrates the Jenny dialogue framework into the Flame game engine.
data.what_it_does: Adds components that allow developers to display and control conversations within a Flame game. It bridges the Jenny dialogue system to Flame’s rendering and event loop.
use_when: You are building a game with Flame and need interactive dialogue or tutorials.
You want to reuse existing Jenny scripts in a Flutter/Flame project.
You need custom commands like <<character>> or <<visit>> in your game conversations.
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame engine or building a non-game Flutter app.
You already have another dialogue system integrated.
You need a standalone dialogue engine without Flame dependencies.
strengths: Seamless integration with Flame’s component system
Supports Jenny’s full command set and built‑in functions
weaknesses: Tied to the Flame engine; not usable in plain Flutter apps
Limited to the features exposed by Jenny; no custom extensions beyond commands
Requires keeping Jenny up to date for new features
